query:
INSERT INTO app.outbox_consumer (consumer, event_type, start_policy, start_seq)
                       SELECT $1, $2, $3,
                              CASE WHEN $3 = 'from_now'
                                   THEN coalesce((SELECT max(seq) FROM app.outbox), 0) + 1
                                   ELSE 1 END
                       ON CONFLICT (consumer, event_type) DO NOTHING
                       RETURNING start_seq
